title: ComparativeResult
description: Aggregated result artifact for a comparative benchmark run across exactly two targets.

comparative_id.description: Unique identifier for this comparative run (UUID v4).

timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp when the comparative run was initiated.

contract_id.description: Contract identifier from scenario fixed_contracts (e.g. fixed_contract_v1).

measurement_seconds.description: Duration of the measurement window in seconds (warmup excluded).

warmup_seconds.description: Duration of the warmup window in seconds (discarded from metrics).

targets.description: Exactly two target result summaries included in this comparison.

tier.description: Target tier. Cross-tier comparisons require explicit override_gates entry.

protocol_mode.description: HTTP protocol mode used during this run.

transport_mode.description: Transport layer and network path. loopback-h1 results are not equivalent to network-path measurements.

throughput_rps.description: Measured throughput in requests per second.

latency_p75_us.description: 75th percentile latency in microseconds (optional but recommended).

latency_p90_us.description: 90th percentile latency in microseconds (optional but recommended).

error_rate_pct.description: Percentage of requests that resulted in errors (0.0–100.0).

total_requests.description: Total number of requests issued during the measurement window.

total_errors.description: Total number of error responses during the measurement window.

fairness_index.description: Computed fairness index for this comparison pair.

gate_status.description: Results of all 8 comparative readiness gates.

maturity.description: Gate A: claim_scope, runner_status, and reproducibility_status requirements.

equivalence.description: Gate B: scenario_id, contract_id, tool, and transport_mode must match across targets.

endpoint.description: Gate C: total_errors == 0 or error_rate_pct < 0.5 for both targets.

payload.description: Gate D: threads, connections, and duration_seconds must match across targets.

error.description: Gate F: error_rate_pct < 1.0 for both targets; WARN if > 0.5.

metadata.description: Gate H: run_id, timestamp, scenario, tool, and env_ref must be populated.

notes.description: Free-form human-readable notes about this comparative run.

override_gates.description: List of gate IDs that have been explicitly overridden with justification.

override_by.description: Identifier of the person or system that approved this override.

known_asymmetries.description: Documented known asymmetries between targets that may affect result interpretation.

pass_fail.description: Gate outcome. FAIL blocks publication; WARN allows with caveats.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the gate outcome.
